mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances during FEDFUNDS decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 5.0%, the combination of high inflation and insufficient monetary tightening compresses real rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0, or interaction effect size < 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion with HOUST decline, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) decline below 1300 and 700000 respectively, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 700000, or interaction effect size < 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), rising inflation signals that the Federal Reserve may maintain high interest rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
